note: Clear blue sky, very much autumn.
Crisp. Cold, but not yet cold in the striking, bracing sense. No killing frost yet; edging toward it.
Sound carries further in the colder air. Crows.
Leaves have turned and are past peak color; the vibrancy is gone. Not all fallen.
Sassafras in the back yard has lost all its leaves.
Maple across the way still holding over half its leaves.
Walking with Emit Kosine - some of the last remaining blooming flowers filled with bees. The smell of the flowers was omnipresent
Bees still on the same flowers. Flowers still in bloom. Smell not as present.
